description: Periodic alignment check — re-reads the active instruction scope and verifies the current task direction is still compliant. Triggered every 6 agent steps per .ai/heartbeat.md.
checklist: 2. Reload effective instructions: run .ai/engine/get_effective_instructions.py for the current path
3. Re-read agent-config.yaml safety settings (requires_approval list, archive_first, log_all_changes)
4. Check for directory drift since last heartbeat — if the active module changed, reload immediately
5. Verify current task direction aligns with reloaded instructions
6. If aligned: call log-action (action: 'heartbeat', outcome: 'aligned') and continue silently
7. If misaligned: stop the current task, report the specific rule conflict and governing file to the user, wait for direction — see .ai/heartbeat.md#misalignment-response
